notes.title: Crystal Vibes developer's game Squingle launched today!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=DEAbZ4WnujI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Before time there was only Squingle 
– and she needs your help to create the Universe![/b][/h2]

The spiraling psychedelic VR puzzle – Liquid crystal levels are alive, mystical, and other-worldly, offering a unique multisensory showcase that must be seen, heard and [i]felt[/i] to be believed. 

Grab the two revolving orbs and guide them through iridescent mazes that twist and turn, forming structures like DNA. Will you discover the meaning of Squingle?


[h3]We've had one media review already, here's what they had to say:[/h3]

Rated 9.1/10 ~  [url=https://www.vr-italia.org/squingle-la-recensione-oculus-quest-pcvr/]VR Italia[/url]

[i]“[b]One of the most fascinating and original things ever seen in the world of video games.[/b]”

“Level design that[b] dwarfs some of the most important AAA studios[/b].”

“Squingle is [b]one of the most beautiful products I have played in the last year[/b] of virtual reality, [b]among the heavyweights like Rez Infinite, Thumper and Tetris Effect[/b].”

“It is definitely [b]ahead of everything that has recently been released[/b] both on Steam VR and on the official Oculus Quest store.”[/i]


[h3]Also on Oculus Quest![/h3] 
Visit:
[url=https://squingle.com/]www.Squingle.com[/url]
